build_EfficientNetV2_backbone: build an EfficientNetV2 backbone model with a specified architecture like small, medium, or large
create_EnhancedConvModule_with_skip: create an EnhancedConvModule with skip connection and stochastic depth drop path for residual learning
run_EfficientNetV2_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the EfficientNetV2 backbone to extract feature maps from input images
freeze_EfficientNetV2_stages: freeze specific stages of the EfficientNetV2 backbone to prevent gradient updates during training
configure_EfficientNetV2_architecture: configure the EfficientNetV2 architecture settings including repeat, kernel size, stride, expand ratio, and block type
